name: Maal
description: Maal was a gas giant located at the intersection of the Authority Guardian Corridor and the Trianii Shunt, in space annexed by the Corporate Sector in 5 BBY. The planet was orbited by Hiit, a moon that was the home of the avian Hiitians.
